paragraphs: Meri: I wrote him above after Mari. [Glosses: Meri. (a) Bava Batra 91a: Meri bar Meri should read bar Mar. (b) Eruvin 64a: 'Meri son of Rav Huna, son of R. Yirmeyah (son of R. Abba)' should read thus, for that incident occurs in Berakhot 31a; not corrected. (c) Gittin 36b: 'Rav, son of Shemuel's daughter' should read 'Rav Meri, son of Shemuel's daughter,' for the same matter occurs in Shabbat 88b.]
